interval_unit: equal-weight birth, paired differences before resampling

protocol.law_design: Within a world A law is crossed with the sign inversion of one independently sampled B law vector.
protocol.trials: Each birth has the same held-out worlds. Within-world law lanes are matched, and K values share a prefix.
protocol.positions: Each object's study and query orientations are sampled independently. Feeder demonstrations expose both antipodes.
protocol.geometry: Each object receives an independent physical antipodal pair. Novel feeder axes avoid the training axis. Fixed-anchor feeder holds only A at the training axis.
protocol.fork: A always studied with writes. For B, write and exposure branches receive their own real tastes with identical decision clocks. The neutral branch advances the same number of ticks with no B sensory stimulus.
protocol.probe: All queries for a given K start from the same post-B state after a common wait. No query delivers taste or commits a write. Query actions use shared draws across treatments and independent draws across objects.
protocol.A_retention_difference_from_K0: A accuracy at K minus A accuracy after its study and probe wait alone.
protocol.B_weakest_object: Minimum of B accuracies by serial position within each birth.
protocol.weakest_studied_object_law: Minimum accuracy over studied serial positions and private laws within each birth.

parameter_distance_from_post_A: field (weights L1, bias L1, changed topology bits)
